title: VOL (ATC) ? INVOL (Agent+ACNP) � Promise = Last VOL Before Agent+ACNP
description:
Customer's ticket was voluntarily changed via ATC (VOL), then an agent with ACNP changed the flight (INVOL). Validates that the promise updates to the last VOL arrival (11:30) and that the subsequent Agent+ACNP does NOT further update the promise.
